summary: Not integrable. Real temporal coverage-read accounting works, but expansion supports only a narrow image-Evidence branch. Required dependency declarations can remain unread without detection; optional attachment accounting and media-scoped receipts are missing. The supplied gate records 24 failing accounting tests.

blocking_findings.description: Independent expansion is implemented only for temporal Evidence backed by image media and an empty PilotSubmission collection. Video Evidence explicitly becomes unavailable, any submission collection becomes unavailable, and every other temporal or warrant root immediately receives 'root obligation expansion unavailable'. Consequently the assigned nine-rule foundation is absent for most valid inputs. The supplied gate's 24 root-profile failures directly expose this omission; unconditional incompleteness does not satisfy prerequisite-accounting acceptance.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Complete the assigned temporal and warrant expansion profiles and their real-consumer reconciliation, preserving INCOMPLETE semantic status. Pass the existing direct and retained root-profile controls without weakening them. If the mandated size stop prevents completion, retain the candidate as non-integrable rather than treating the implemented subset as acceptance.

blocking_findings.description: Even the supported image branch does not expand all applicable dependency declarations. Evidence fields are iterated, but MediaAsset is handled by a hard-coded type read. In isolated executions of the actual accounting, preparer and reader code on direct and in-memory SQLite paths, adding 'revision=count' to the live MediaAsset declarations produced diagnostics=(), successful support and no revision obligation. Adding a missing required text field likewise passed. The unread-declaration test mutates only Evidence, so it misses this surviving form of the Step 0032 defect.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Expand applicable declarations for dependency records as well as roots, using explicit checked activation metadata. Add independently specified missing and available-but-unread dependency-declaration controls on both reader paths, asserting the exact diagnostic and denied support.

blocking_findings.description: The binding checked-optionality remedy remains absent. A PilotSubmission with checked empty frame_indices and explicit null derivative is accepted by the integrated temporal preparer, but the new audit rejects it as an unsupported root and records no checked-inactive derivative obligation. Independent direct and in-memory SQLite probes reproduced this difference. Only Evidence timestamp inactivity is implemented; there is no attachment activation rule or accounting oracle for the required valid empty/null branch.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Preserve the valid empty-indices/null-derivative branch through the audit with a retained checked justification. Implement the corresponding active and unavailable attachment obligations, and add direct/retained valid, false-active, false-inactive and malformed-discriminant controls with deletion witnesses.

blocking_findings.description: Media-scoped preparation and root classification do not exist. audit accepts only a root reference and profile; classified is always left empty. There is no exact media-scope pin, membership chain, ACTIVE/excluded-root accounting or scoped aggregation caller. Receipt.merge merely concatenates manually supplied receipts. The merge test combines two unrelated image roots and checks selected fields, so it cannot establish that every classified root contributes its expected, observed and checked-inactive obligations. The planned lint_context implementation and tests are absent.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Implement the assigned media-only scope preparation with checked exact membership and retained classifications, and aggregate each classified root's complete receipt. Add literal active, excluded, mixed and empty-scope expectations, identity/revision and damaged-link negatives, and dropped-contribution/ledger deletion controls.

blocking_findings.description: The acceptance suite is both failing and materially incomplete. All 24 broad root-profile controls fail in the supplied gate. The passing focused tests establish an image coverage VALUE omission, selected consumption faults, root declaration changes and timestamp inactivity, but do not establish warrant-consumer omission sensitivity, independent activation/use/association inventories, the other boundary-mode deletion controls, media scope or dropped aggregation. The broad controls assert only nonempty ledgers and generic support, so they cannot replace literal whole-profile expectations. The single reconciliation deletion witness removes the entire reconciliation function rather than covering each new guard.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Complete the sealed independent inventories and focused controls for the implemented guards, including literal subject/state/path/reason, valid counterparts, denied support and targeted deletion witnesses on direct and retained paths. Preserve all existing tests and make the current root-profile acceptance tests pass.
